intro: The Restomagic Latex Mattress is designed to support, soothe, and cool, making every night feel like a retreat. Because you deserve more than just sleep—you deserve deep, restorative rest.

features.title: Breathable fabric for a soothing sleep
features.text: Stay cool and comfortable with the high GSM quilted top fabric, offering a soothing texture and enhanced airflow for uninterrupted sleep.

features.title: Soft quilting adds an extra layer of comfort
features.text: Your bed should welcome you the moment you lie down, and our plush quilted top does exactly that, offering soft, breathable comfort that helps you unwind with ease.

features.title: Responsive Latex Foam
features.text: Delivers a naturally responsive bounce as it adapts to your body movements while evenly distributing pressure. Latex foam helps maintain healthy posture alignment, making it ideal for relieving stress on joints and muscles.

features.title: Comforting Softly Foam
features.text: Designed to balance support and comfort, this medium-firm mattress cradles you softly while ensuring proper spine alignment and pressure relief.

features.title: Anti-skid base keeps you stable and safe
features.text: Our anti-skid base keeps your mattress firmly in place, preventing unwanted slipping so you can enjoy safe, uninterrupted sleep every night.

features.title: Stay reassured with our 5 year warranty
features.text: Rest easy with the assurance of a 5-year warranty. Crafted for durability and reliability, this mattress is backed by our commitment to quality, ensuring years of unmatched comfort and peace of mind.

name: Restomagic Latex Double Bed Foam Mattress 78 X 48 X 6 Inches
